title: SUBDATA: Bridging Heterogeneous Datasets to Enable Theory-Driven Evaluation of Political and Demographic Perspectives in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with left-leaning and right-leaning personas and comparing their respective hate speech detection rates across various demographic groups.
Measuring and comparing the proportion of text flagged as hate speech when the content specifically targets different racial groups (e.g., Blacks, Asians, Whites, Latinos).
Evaluating model sensitivity and detection rates for hate speech directed at religious identities such as Muslims, Jews, and Christians.
Assessing differences in hate speech classification for content targeting gender groups, specifically women and men.
Comparing hate speech detection rates for content targeting the LGBTQ+ community.
Standardizing heterogeneous datasets containing hate speech targeted at specific age groups to enable consistent perspective evaluation.
Harmonizing target annotations in datasets focused on hate speech directed at individuals with disabilities.
Integrating and categorizing datasets of hate speech targeting individuals based on their geographic origin or migration status.
